name: Presence
source:
A sequel to Nostalgia 1907, Presence tells a totally different story. Hero is a psychoanalytic on board of a hijacked aircraft. Can the terrorist be reasoned with? Is there any hope for survival?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/06/vn-of-month-october-1992.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
《存在》是《怀旧1907》的续作，但讲述了完全不同的故事。主人公是一名登上被劫持飞机的精神分析师。他能说服恐怖分子吗？幸存的希望还存在吗？

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/06/vn-of-month-october-1992.html]vndbreview[/url]]
